comments.text: Initial 80-run controller terminated by SIGTERM after only stylesheet-off batch. Source shows ready.request explicitly reannounces when publicReady=true; stylesheet removal can resolve pending readiness before ready.request processing. Reconnect test predicate .not.toBe(after.pid) also permits undefined (no session), so it is not a complete reconnect barrier. Need complete paired results before final conclusion.
